reasoning: New Track-B parents replace the exhausted sphere body: growth-driven mid-surface (P0) and the Okuda monolayer route (P2). On P0 I test the two cell_rd_seed synergies (+divide_3d +0.586, +reconnect_t1_3d +0.537) predicted to raise, morphogen necessity, cell_geometry, and a uniform_ramp excursion. I mirror the productive edits on the P2 monolayer (Okuda geometry) with its OWN in-batch control, fixing round 9's missing-baseline flaw. ~70/30 confirmatory/adversarial and in_paper/excursion.

adding division to a cell_rd_seed base amplifies the protrusion via the measured synergy.
slots.why: cell_rd_seed+divide_3d SYNERGY +0.586; P0 already carries cell_rd_seed, so the pair should raise despite divide_3d solo -0.347.

slots.why: morphogen_growth_3d is established NECESSARY on the sphere body; confirms necessity carries to the new base (Okuda uncoupled_growth analogue).

slots.why: cell_geometry_3d solo -0.275 'insufficient'; maps whether it is inert or load-bearing on this base.

slots.why: isolates patterned vs unpatterned growth on the monolayer; uniform_ramp was destabilising on the sphere. REFUTED if stable protr_peak >= 1.3.

slots.why: reconnect_t1_3d was inert on the sphere; tests whether the monolayer's remodeling actually needs T1 transitions (Okuda uses them for tubulation).

slots.why: uncoupled_growth regime; if the monolayer still deforms without morphogen, patterning is NOT necessary on this base -- a genuine map surprise.

slots.claim: removing cell_geometry_3d leaves the monolayer protrusion essentially unchanged.
slots.why: cell_geometry_3d solo -0.275 'insufficient'; mirrors slot 5 on the monolayer to see if it is inert on both bases.
